source.method: Figma MCP Plugin API, read-only batched export

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-primary
variables.description: → white · Default surface. Cards, panels, page canvas.

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-secondary
variables.description: → neutral/50 · One step recessed. Page background behind cards.

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-tertiary
variables.description: → neutral/100 · Two steps recessed. Table headers, wells, inactive tabs.

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-emphasis
variables.description: → neutral/200 · Stronger than primary. Hover on neutral surfaces.

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-inverse
variables.description: → neutral/900 · Inverted surface. Dark sections, tooltips.

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-inverse-secondary
variables.description: → neutral/800 · Recessed area inside an inverted surface.

variables.name: Background/Base/bg-overlay
variables.description: → neutral/950 · Modal scrim. Apply at ~60% opacity.

variables.name: Background/Brand/bg-brand-emphasis
variables.description: → brand/700 · Solid brand fill, stronger. Hover.

variables.name: Background/Brand/bg-brand-secondary
variables.description: → brand/50 · Light brand tint. Selected rows, info banners.

variables.name: Background/Brand/bg-brand-secondary-emphasis
variables.description: → brand/100 · Light brand tint, stronger. Hover on tinted surface.

variables.name: Text/Base/text-emphasis
variables.description: → brand/600 · Emphasised text. Brand-coloured, stronger than primary.

variables.name: Icon/Base/icon-emphasis
variables.description: → brand/600 · Emphasised icon. Brand-coloured, stronger than primary.

variables.name: Border/Base/border-primary
variables.description: → neutral/200 · Default control and card border.

variables.name: Border/Base/border-secondary
variables.description: → neutral/100 · Faint divider. Inside cards, list rows.

variables.name: Border/Base/border-emphasis
variables.description: → neutral/300 · Stronger border. Hover on inputs.

variables.name: Border/Brand/border-brand-secondary
variables.description: → brand/200 · Soft brand outline. Selected cards.
